newsitem.title: LATVIA: Latvian shares edge up in light trade.
newsitem.headline: Latvian shares edge up in light trade.

text.p: Latvian shares edged up on Thursday with market turnover a touch higher, the stock exchange said.
Overall market volume was 80,317 lats, up from 71,830 on Wednesday. On the official list, leading share Unibanka was most traded on 28,955 lats as it fell to 2.31 lats from 2.35 lats.
The other share on the official list, Riga Transport Fleet, rose by one santime to 1.01 lats and traded 20,000 lats.
On the secondary list, trade was light with the Daugavpils chain maker busy on activity of 11,555 lats. It fell to 1.11 lats from 1.14 lats.
